meta.title: Rental Property Due Diligence — 14homehouston listing set
meta.listing_source: 14 WhatsApp screenshots of Zillow share links committed to this repository (IMG_3489–IMG_3506.jpg)
meta.screenshot_note: IMG_3503 duplicates IMG_3490 (117 Bayou Bend Ct). IMG_3506 carries a front-elevation render with no link. 12 unique Zillow URLs remain.
meta.zillow_access_note: zillow.com returns HTTP 403 to this environment (bot protection), as do trulia.com, har.com and newhomesource.com. Listing facts were therefore verified against the builders' own websites (lennar.com, centurycommunities.com, drhorton.com) and redfin.com, each retrieved 4 October 2026. Where the builder and an aggregator disagree, the builder's own site is treated as authoritative and the discrepancy is recorded.
